title: A field from a secondary page stores OCCURSLEVEL = its level + the secondary page's level and SECOCCURSLEVEL = its own level
statement: The Select Fields search (EOCC_SELECT_FIELDS SEARCH_BTN FieldChange, "Correct the level of the fields from secondary page") sets SECOCCURSLEVEL to the field's key level and adds the level the secondary page is reached at to OCCURSLEVEL. A component page's field keeps SECOCCURSLEVEL 0.

observations.observation: The delivered SEARCH_BTN FieldChange sets SECOCCURSLEVEL = OCCURSLEVEL then OCCURSLEVEL += the secondary page level for page type S; stored rows on an 8.61.15 database (secondary pages opened from a grid) carry exactly these values, and no 8.62.09 lab row has a secondary page reached below level 0.
